dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Mellow Yellow was brought to MACC as an owner surrender. In his previous home he is noted to have a bite incident pertaining to resource guarding food that he had. His previous owner also states that Mellow will lunge at cats while on leash. In care, Mellow is observed to persistently jump up on handlers amd become tense with a toy in his possession. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult-only home.
dog.name: Mello Yellow
